query_original: What is the minimum car mass, before Nominal Tyre Mass, during Sprint Qualifying and Qualifying sessions in the 2026 F1 Technical Regulations?
resposta: According to Article C4.1 of the 2026 F1 Technical Regulations, during Sprint Qualifying and Qualifying sessions, the Minimum Mass is 726kg plus the Nominal Tyre Mass. Therefore, the minimum car mass, before Nominal Tyre Mass, during these sessions is 726kg.
